description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawala, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels, including land numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and property ownership matters, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
